goals.statement: Check the next day's temperature, including the hourly reading for the time of going out, in order to choose between a thick coat and a light coat.
conditions: Checked the day before
Hourly temperature read for the morning before classes, around the time of going out

supported_parts: 按出门时刻的小时级温度查看
support.label: direct
support.rationale: 原文明确说用天气信息查看温度以决定穿厚外套还是薄外套，并补充按出门前后的小时级温度查看；主体、对象与预期结果一致。

goals.statement: Check the next day's chance of rain and make sure to carry an umbrella when rain is forecast.
conditions: Checked the day before
A precipitation chance of 25 percent or more is treated as a good chance of rain

supported_parts: 有降雨预报时确保带伞
support.label: direct
support.rationale: 原文明确：若有降雨预报就确保带伞；25% 以上算较大降雨可能，来自同一回答，作为其判断标准保留，未另设阈值。

goals.statement: Skip cycling and take the bus instead when it is super cold.
conditions: Condition: super cold weather
Cycling in the cold is unpleasant

support.label: direct
support.rationale: 原文明确给出天很冷时不骑车、改坐公交的选择，条件与替代方式一致；原文用 might，属习惯性取舍，未写成硬性规则。

goals.statement: Notice warnings about important or severe weather events, especially when they affect my own city.
conditions: weather.com is where the stakeholder would first see such events
Events for the stakeholder's city would definitely be noticed

supported_parts: 获知重要/恶劣天气事件的警告
特别关注发生在自己城市的event
support.label: direct
support.rationale: 原文明确说站点会警告重要天气事件，且若发生在自己城市一定会注意到，并将其视为获知这类事件的第一处。

goals.statement: Read news details about important weather events happening around the world from the main page.
conditions: Main page shows event sections, including events outside the stakeholder's city
Clicking opens a news tab with details

supported_parts: 主页提供全球重要天气事件
点开新闻页查看事件细节
support.label: direct
support.rationale: 受访者自述主页有全球重要天气事件栏目并会点开新闻页查看细节，据此表述阅读全球事件新闻；未添加频率或范围要求。

goals.statement: When an alert about an extreme weather event arrives, open the notification and read the severity, details and official recommendations in order to determine whether to evacuate, seek shelter, stay indoors, or just carry an umbrella and a raincoat.
conditions: Stated as what would probably happen; the stakeholder says they have never been in a city during an extreme weather event
The response depends on the severity and the information given

supported_parts: 阅读官方建议以确定行动
support.label: direct
support.rationale: 原文明确描述收到警报后会打开通知、查看严重程度与细节，并阅读官方建议以决定撤离/避险/留在室内等做法；属设想情境（受访者未经历过城市极端天气），已在 context 保留。

goals.statement: Adjust the day's plan according to the alert's severity and the information provided.
conditions: Based on the alert's severity and the information given

supported_parts: 按警报信息调整当天安排
support.label: direct
support.rationale: 原文明确“基于此调整我的一天”，条件为警报严重程度与所给信息；未扩展为其他调整方式。

goals.statement: Start checking historical data or monthly/seasonal forecasts as soon as a trip is decided, in order to estimate temperature, precipitation and cloud cover weeks ahead.
conditions: Checked immediately once the trip is known
Weeks before departure

supported_parts: 查历史数据或月度预报
support.label: direct
support.rationale: 原文明确：一确定要出行就查历史数据或月度/未来预报，以对天气有大致估计；时间条件（提前数周）与查询方式均保留。

goals.statement: Use forecast cloud cover to judge whether the trip's purpose (enjoying sun at a beach, viewing an astronomical event) is still achievable, and reconsider or cancel the trip if it will be overcast.
conditions: Applies to trips whose purpose depends on clear skies

supported_parts: 云量不利时重新考虑或取消
support.label: direct
support.rationale: 原文明确除温度与降水外还看云量，并举海滩晒太阳与观星为例说明可能需重新考虑或取消；原文为泛化第二人称建议，未扩大为所有行程。

goals.statement: Wait until two or three days before departure and then make the final go/no-go decision based on the more accurate temperature forecast.
conditions: Two or three days before departure
Forecast is usually right at that range

supported_parts: 按最终温度做去/不去的决定
support.label: direct
support.rationale: 原文明确建议等到出发前两三天，再按最终温度决定去不去；保留“probably”的建议强度，未写成硬性规则。

goals.statement: Screenshot a below-zero temperature reading and share it on social media, because such temperatures are unusual where I come from.
conditions: Stated as a plan; not yet done
When a below-zero temperature reading appears

support.label: direct
support.rationale: 原文明确说计划很快这么做：显示零下温度时截图并发到社交媒体；同时说明尚未做过，已在 context 标注。

goals.statement: See at most one or two ads, with no video pop-ups, so that checking the weather stays quick and undistracted.
conditions: The page currently carries four or five ads, some of them video pop-ups

supported_parts: 目的是快速、不受打扰地查看
support.label: direct
support.rationale: 原文给出可接受上限（一两条广告），并说四五条加视频弹窗过多、打断快速查看；数量与结果均来自原话。

goals.statement: Arrange related weather information more compactly, as a tentative suggestion, so that it can be read without scrolling past large ad blocks.
conditions: Stated as a tentative suggestion ('maybe they can')

supported_parts: 避免大块广告隔断、减少滚动
support.label: direct
support.rationale: 原文明确建议把界面压紧、让内容彼此靠近以便阅读，起因是广告把内容隔开、需要上下滚动；保留试探性语气。

goals.statement: Make the radar section more detailed and intuitive, with multiple parameters such as snow coverage and precipitation and with animations.
conditions: Compared with windy.com, which the stakeholder uses for its radar and animations

support.label: direct
support.rationale: 原文明确说雷达可以更好，可加入雪覆盖、降水等多参数，并以更详细直观的雷达产品作参照；动画来自其对 windy.com 的偏好，一并保留在目标中。

goals.statement: Provide very local weather for specific places such as a hiking trail, a mountain-climbing route, or a hotel in a remote area, not just city-level weather.
conditions: When the destination is not a city

supported_parts: 提供非城市地点的本地天气
场景为徒步/登山/偏僻酒店
support.label: direct
support.rationale: 原文明确“非常本地的数据会很有帮助”，场景为徒步、登山与偏僻酒店，并说明城市级信息在此不够用。

goals.statement: View temperatures in Celsius instead of the default Fahrenheit.
conditions: US default is Fahrenheit
A unit switch exists at the top of the page

support.label: direct
support.rationale: 原文明确偏好摄氏显示，且说明可通过顶部下拉切换；作为偏好保留，未升级为强制要求。

conditions: On Mac/PC
Stated as 'I just prefer it off'

support.label: direct
support.rationale: 原文明确偏好不收通知并已保持关闭，属维持现状的避免型目标；限定在 Mac/PC 使用情境。

goals.statement: Keep location data in a locally clearable cache rather than stored on the service, so that a leak cannot reveal which city I am from.
conditions: Concern is conditional on being logged in
The storage location is the stakeholder's guess, not verified

inference.reason: 由“数据在本地缓存即可清掉、不必担心被存储”与登录时担心泄露可识别城市，推断出对位置数据本地可清除、不被留存的偏好。
assumptions: 受访者关于存储位置的判断是猜测；本目标只承接其偏好方向，不声称站点确实不存储。

supported_parts: 希望位置数据可自行清除
登录时担心泄露暴露城市
assumptions: 受访者对缓存/存储位置的判断是猜测，但偏好方向不依赖该判断成立
reasoning_steps: 由其“可清缓存、不必担心被存储”的表述推断出对本地可清除的偏好
由登录状态下对泄露的担忧推断出对服务端留存的回避
support.label: inferred
support.rationale: 原文没有直接提出隐私要求，只说数据在本地缓存就能清掉、不必担心被存储，并在登录状态下担心泄露可识别城市。据此推断其希望位置数据可本地清除且不被服务端留存，故判 inferred；未把其“应该只存在本地”的猜测当作已核实事实。
